topic: B2B SEO in the Age of AI Search
headline: AI Search Only Feels New If Your SEO Was Shallow via @sejournal, @slobodanmanic
keyNotes: Surprisingly, the way new AI search tools work isn't really new if your business was already following good practices for search engines like Google; the article says that if you focused on being clear and trustworthy online, you're well-prepared.

Even though how search engines work has changed with AI, the basic thing they look for hasn't; they still want to find the clearest, most consistent, and most reliable information about your business.

What *is* genuinely more important now is making sure your business's information is consistent and accurate everywhere it appears online, not just on your own website, because AI tools gather information from many different places.

Instead of just checking if your business shows up for general searches, the article suggests directly asking AI tools about your own brand and products to see what they "believe" and where they get their information, which helps you find and fix any wrong details.
question: If AI tools are gathering information about your business from everywhere online, not just your website, what are some unexpected places they might be getting information that could be wrong or outdated?
